Draymond Green scored the Warriors' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 16 times in 70 starts, or 23% of the games they started. Moses Moody was next with 12. The Warriors made the game's first field goal in 50% of their 84 games and won 46% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
